title: Arithmetic Readiness and Repair
role: Adaptive support layer with complete instruction for students who need numerical repair.
governing_question: What must be dependable about numbers before symbols can carry meaning?

title: Quantities, Variables, and Mathematical Objects
act: Act I - Giving general names to quantities
role: Establish what algebra describes before asking students to manipulate it.
governing_question: How can symbols name quantities and relationships without erasing their meaning?

title: Expressions, Equality, and Linear Equations
act: Act II - Preserving truth while changing form
role: Build the central equivalence engine of elementary algebra.
governing_question: How can an equation change form without changing its solutions?

title: Inequalities, Absolute Value, and Formulas
act: Act III - Describing regions and constraints
role: Extend algebra from exact equality to ranges, distance conditions, and reusable formulas.
governing_question: How do we describe all values satisfying a condition?

title: Ratios, Rates, and Linear Relationships
act: Act IV - Turning constant change into lines
role: Connect proportional reasoning, slope, equations, graphs, and linear models.
governing_question: How do two quantities change together at a constant rate?

title: Systems and Simultaneous Constraints
act: Act V - Satisfying several conditions at once
role: Extend linear reasoning to multiple equations, variables, and feasible regions.
governing_question: Which values satisfy several requirements simultaneously?

title: Exponents, Roots, and Power Structure
act: Act VI - Leaving constant additive change
role: Introduce repeated multiplication, its inverse questions, and the first nonlinear families.
governing_question: How do repeated multiplication and roots create new structures?

title: Polynomial Operations and Special Products
act: Act VII - Building expressions from powers
role: Develop the forward multiplication machinery needed for factoring and quadratics.
governing_question: How can expressions built from powers be combined systematically?

title: Factoring and Quadratic Equations
role: Use reverse multiplication to expose zeros and develop the full quadratic-solving toolkit.
governing_question: How can hidden product structure reveal solutions?

title: Quadratic Functions and Models
act: Act IX - One nonlinear object, several useful forms
role: Connect quadratic equations to parabola geometry, modeling, and optimization.
governing_question: What does each algebraic form reveal about a parabola?

title: Rational Expressions, Equations, and Variation
act: Act X - Tracking where division is allowed
role: Develop algebra with variable denominators, explicit restrictions, and inverse variation.
governing_question: What changes when a variable expression appears in a denominator?

title: Radicals, Rational Exponents, and Complex Numbers
act: Act XI - Reversing powers and enlarging the number system
role: Develop exact root arithmetic, radical equations, extraneous-solution logic, and basic complex arithmetic.
governing_question: How do we reverse powers, and what happens when the real numbers are insufficient?

title: Functions as a Unifying Language
act: Act XII - Organizing algebra around input and output
role: Consolidate earlier relationships into function language without preempting full Precalculus theory.
governing_question: How can one input-output framework organize the algebraic families already studied?

title: Exponential and Logarithmic Algebra
act: Act XIII - Describing multiplicative change and undoing it
role: Complete the Algebra course with repeated proportional change, inverse exponentiation, and equation solving.
governing_question: How do we describe multiplicative change and solve for an unknown exponent?

title: Algebra Synthesis and Precalculus Readiness
act: Finale - Choosing structure instead of chapter labels
role: Turn accumulated techniques into independent classification, strategy, checking, and modeling.
governing_question: When the problem is unlabeled, how do we decide what structure it has and what method applies?
